content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Newport News

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—which account for your bachelor's degree status and years leading projects—before applying. Granite PM Academy can guide you through verification to ensure you meet all prerequisites.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend interactive sessions from your location, learn from active certified practitioners, and earn the 35 required contact hours. Our flexible scheduling accommodates Newport News professionals in shipbuilding, healthcare, aerospace, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee and allow time for application review. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process and required supporting materials to streamline approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam at a Pearson Vue testing center. Test your knowledge of project integration, scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you'll earn the PMP credential valid for three years. Maintain your certification by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or mentoring. Track your PDUs and renew before expiration to keep your credential active throughout your career.
